rationale: Positives: The agent verified the user via email, correctly located the relevant orders, correctly explained that delivered items can’t be canceled but can be returned, and successfully initiated returns for the specified bookshelf and jigsaw from #W6239298 and the backpack from #W9218746. Negatives (policy violations and outcome gaps): 1) The agent performed order-changing writes without explicit confirmation. In particular, it modified the pending order item (including charging an extra $17.86) without restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit approval first. 2) It attempted to change the shipping address without explicit confirmation of the address. 3) It failed to complete the user’s combined request to change the item color and update the shipping address to the default Chicago address; the sequence of actions made the address change impossible and led to a handoff. 4) Some returns were processed without explicit confirmation of refund method for the backpack (it assumed the prior preference). Overall, missing confirmations and failure to complete the requested shipping address update mean the agent did not complete the user’s request in line with policy.
